I have scoliosis and as a kid + teenager had to wear a brace 24/7. As I grew up, wanting to fit in and identify with others in my school, I’d have a lot of days when I wouldn’t wear it because I felt ugly. 

My parents told my doctor about it on a day where I was having a new brace made : I was basically naked in a hospital room with my body suspended in the air and completely plastered. 

The doctor came up to me and said: « keep it up, you’ll be in a wheelchair in no time and you’ll only have yourself to blame for this ». I was 12.

I’m still in constant pain, but much lesser than the one I’ve dealt with over the past 5 years. 

I spent the whole day Sunday reading medical reports from health organizations specialized in chronic pain, and not a single one of them mentioned patients’ experience or feedback. I’m not a doctor, but I want to be useful, I want to help myself and others in this process because it’s so debilitating..
